description: OmniStack Digital builds fast, self-hosted websites you own outright. You get the code, the keys and the hosting account, with no monthly platform fees.

about.heading: I started OmniStack after watching too many small businesses pay a platform forever for something they could have owned in a fortnight.
about.story: One person, start to finish. You talk to the person writing the code, and nothing about your site lives anywhere you can't reach.

announcement.text: New: Banafee Group, a bilingual corporate site shipped end to end.

hero.headline: Websites you actually own.
hero.subhead: Fast, self-hosted sites for businesses that are finished renting their own storefront. You get the code, the keys, the hosting account, and an invoice that actually ends.

trustLabel: Trusted by founders, agencies, and teams shipping at scale.

valuePillars.title: Own the code
valuePillars.body: The repository, the assets, the deploy pipeline, handed over in full. Hire anyone next. Or nobody.

valuePillars.title: Zero recurring fees
valuePillars.body: Hosting runs a few dollars a month, paid to your host, not to me. No plan tiers, no ransom on your own pages.

valuePillars.title: Built for speed
valuePillars.body: Hand-written markup, no plugin sediment. Sub-second loads on a phone with two bars of signal.

servicesIntro: Everything you need to design, build, and grow a modern digital product, under one roof.

aiShowcase.title: AI that does the work, not demos.
aiShowcase.body: We design agents and automations that handle real operations, wired into your stack and monitored in production. Not a chatbot bolted on; systems that move the work forward.
points: Generate and repurpose content on brand
Sync data between the tools you already use

process.intro: Two to four weeks, one person, no account management layer between you and the work.

steps.title: Audit
steps.body: I go through what you have, what it costs you monthly, and what's actually losing you enquiries. You get the findings whether or not we work together.

steps.title: Build
steps.body: Design and code in one pass, on your own hosting from day one. You watch it take shape on a live staging link, not in a slide deck.

steps.title: Review
steps.body: Two rounds of changes, marked up directly on the page. Copy, layout, photography: we settle it before launch, not after.

steps.title: Handover
steps.body: Repo, domain, hosting, analytics and a short video walkthrough, all in your name. Support if you want it, never as a condition.

cta.headline: Ready to own your website, not rent it?
cta.body: Send one paragraph about your business. You'll get a straight answer on cost, timeline and whether I'm the right person for it.
cta.reassurance: We reply within one business day.

pricing.intro: Clear scope, clear timeline, clear price. Pick the way of working that fits, and you get a fixed quote before anything starts.
pricing.note: Every engagement starts with a free scoping call. No hourly billing, no surprises.

models.name: Project
models.tagline: Fixed-scope builds, delivered end to end.
features: Design and build by one person

newsletter.title: Notes on shipping better products
newsletter.body: Occasional, practical writing on design, engineering, and AI. No spam, unsubscribe anytime.

booking.heading: Book a free scoping call
booking.intro: A short call to understand what you're building. You'll leave with a clear sense of scope, timeline, and next steps, with no pressure and no jargon.
